about: A command line tool that checks Markdown files for style and formatting problems.

prs.title: Linting files outside the current folder no longer crashes
prs.broken: With an ignore file in the current folder, linting a Markdown file from another folder crashed before checking anything, and the exit looked like a lint failure.
prs.changed: Files outside the current folder now skip that ignore file, since its patterns can't match them, and are linted normally.
prs.matters: Editors and scripts that lint files across folders get real results instead of a crash.
